result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **Dropbox Sign** for simplicity and value, or **DocuSign** if you want the most established, widely recognized platform.

However, the best choice depends on how often you send contracts, how many employees need access, and whether you need more than basic signatures.

Here are my top five picks for 2026.

## Best e-signature software for small businesses

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best overall for simplicity)

# \$15/mo

- Easy to use for customers and employees.
- Templates and signing workflows.
- Unlimited signature requests on paid plans.
- Good Dropbox integration.

Website: [Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![AlignedPartner - Partner Program Consulting](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6SBWynbkn-bwRkCuMIHuBO284Y100e0fDpdUDFLZztrUUgkyW1-tpHcC5kTOqtjz5KB_xBScAISRTstaI0F65z5jXu0N46he4NZBZ6WfWk96sgJLpvvT2RrcS-xO0hh1EvFzwRy6VbJduS4ruy6JYed3q5wUxhQz8NAeUe2M3V1pVOdebhqoA5Ko-m3kjQ5x?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best for professional contracts)

# \$11+/mo

- Widely recognized by customers and businesses.
- Strong audit trails and authentication options.
- Excellent integrations.
- Good for growing businesses.

Website: [DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/)

---

![PandaDoc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/opy__qKCrCsIKnnF5NHqBYNkFSD9tFJxhM39aLVUKpNw8OxuNc3sSNOdGSyNGxaqIKKrmce4TuaVLmGO9eSbwlpx_ArOoLhxrlRmtBC9tAc0Mt_Es7zHktC9aUhmHT5EUOLg6P9MGqBrXjzTrjD1lx16SP7BAihCSKTMGiqzFSlJl3OCCns1gQY78yXl07V_?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PandaDoc**

(Best for proposals and sales)

# \$19/user/mo

- Create professional proposals and contracts.
- Electronic signatures built in.
- Document templates and workflow automation.
- Useful for sales teams and client onboarding.

Website: [PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

---

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. SignWell**

(Best budget option)

# \$10–12/mo

- Simple, straightforward signing.
- Free plan for up to 3 documents monthly.
- Reusable templates.
- Good for freelancers and small businesses.

Website: [SignWell](https://www.signwell.com/)

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

(Best for PDF documents)

# \$16.99+/mo

- PDF editing and electronic signatures.
- Excellent document management.
- Integrates with Adobe Acrobat.
- Good for businesses that work with lots of PDFs.

Website: [Adobe Acrobat Sign](https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/business/e-signature.html)

Prices are indicative starting prices in USD; billing terms, seats, and sending limits vary by plan. ## My recommendation

| If your priority is... | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Easy contracts and signatures | Dropbox Sign |
| Professional business agreements | DocuSign |
| Proposals, quotes and sales | PandaDoc |
| Lowest cost | SignWell |
| PDF editing and signing | Adobe Sign |
